description: This file defines various classes for Instance Normalization layers in PyTorch, including standard and lazy versions for 1D, 2D, and 3D inputs, with detailed handling of input dimensions, state dict loading, and normalization logic.

classes.name: _InstanceNorm
classes.description: Base class implementing core instance normalization logic, handling input dimension checks, state dict loading, and forward pass.

classes.name: InstanceNorm1d
classes.description: Applies instance normalization over 1D inputs, with optional learnable affine parameters and tracking of running stats.

classes.name: LazyInstanceNorm1d
classes.description: Lazy version of InstanceNorm1d with automatic inference of feature size from input.

classes.name: InstanceNorm2d
classes.description: Applies instance normalization over 2D inputs, suitable for image data.

classes.name: LazyInstanceNorm2d
classes.description: Lazy version of InstanceNorm2d with automatic inference of feature size from input.

classes.name: InstanceNorm3d
classes.description: Applies instance normalization over 3D inputs, suitable for volumetric data.

classes.name: LazyInstanceNorm3d
classes.description: Lazy version of InstanceNorm3d with automatic inference of feature size from input.

methods.name: _check_input_dim
methods.description: Checks if the input tensor has the expected number of dimensions for the specific instance norm class.

methods.name: _get_no_batch_dim
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions excluding batch dimension for normalization.

methods.name: _apply_instance_norm
methods.description: Performs the actual instance normalization using functional API.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict
methods.description: Handles loading of state dictionary, especially when tracking stats is disabled.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the normalization process on the input tensor.
